top_choice_rationale: P001 awards GLP-1 physiology and the active incretin peptide to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov. It is a mature, independently confirmed chain from hormone physiology and the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide to therapies with replicated randomised evidence in type 2 diabetes and obesity. The three-person allocation and the citation scope are defensible, and the clinical impact is large. No award is clearly inferior to this proposal.
